blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Siargao’s premier local bet John Mark “Marama” Tokong concluded his campaign at the World Surf League (WSL) Philippines Pro on Sunday, falling to Australian tour standout Ethan Ewing in Round 2 of the men’s division at Cloud 9 in General Luna, Siargao Island. Tokong’s exit followed a historic opening day, when the Filipino wildcard sent shockwaves across the surfing world by dominating Brazil’s Samuel Pupo, ranked No. 10 in the world. Tokong posted a commanding 16.60-11.00 victory in Heat 7 of Men’s Round 1 on Saturday, cleanly navigating the hollow right-hand reef break to earn […]...
